## Checklist

- [ ] Small and focused; Conventional Commit title
- [ ] Commits signed off (`git commit -s`)
- [ ] Tests / docs updated where relevant
- [ ] Every cultural or medicinal claim has a **source** (no invented facts)
- [ ] No real community knowledge, personal data or secrets included
- [ ] If this touches consent / visibility / `ai_use`: default is the **most restrictive**, and tests cover it
- [ ] If this affects an architectural decision: ADR added or updated
- [ ] New dependencies: licence and maintenance noted below
